svg.title: Oxygen — turn agent sessions into knowledge worth keeping
svg.desc: Animated illustration of one agent session. You corrected the agent (“Don’t just retry the test. Find out why CI fails.”) and the agent discovered the cause (“The code was fine. CI runs in UTC.”). The highlighted phrases fly into the Oxygen orb, which strikes out “forgotten lesson” and rewrites it as “reusable lesson”. Oxygen then produces a summary (“Why CI failed: timezone, not code.”) and a reusable skill (“Tests fail only in CI? Before changing code, check the timezone.”). A reviewer presses Keep in the review bar (Review, Keep, Edit, Decline, Export) and the skill is stamped Kept.
